before.method: Two independent Legacy browser contexts. Initial join/setup unthrottled; clients throttled per run.cpuSlowdown (DM) and run.playerCpuSlowdown (Player, defaults to DM rate) before DM enables Player view and during movement. Software Canvas2D, WebGL blocked throughout. Server unthrottled on same host; no network delay/RAM cap. Epoch timestamps on same host; release-to-token/sight latency includes server communication plus two RAF paint opportunities. Event-driven cached token layer draw handler and SVG MutationObserver; no polling or continuous RAF probe. Separate idle-with-instrumentation baseline. Recording and probes add overhead. Both documents kept visible. Private drag previews do not move the DM view until a committed drop.

gpuPreference.method: Fresh installed Chrome per sample; low/high/high/low order. Same 24 goblins, 8 lights, 4 walls, balanced quality, DPR1, 1440x960. 5s warmup after models ready, 7s stationary + 7s accepted token movement. Counts actual distinct painted miniature frames. getContext override only changes powerPreference and records original request, effective attributes and driver. No forced adapter, CPU throttle or recording.
